name: finch-cloudbase
description: Connect Tencent CloudBase (腾讯云开发) to Finch — configure credentials once and get on-demand access to CloudBase's full MCP toolset: document/relational database, cloud functions, static hosting, storage and authentication.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npx @finchtoys/minitools doctor .

finch.name: CloudBase
finch.description: Connect Tencent CloudBase (腾讯云开发) and load its full MCP toolset on demand — database, cloud functions, static hosting, storage, auth.
finch.systemPrompt: Use cloudbase_setup to connect a Tencent CloudBase (腾讯云开发) environment before doing any CloudBase work. action=login mounts the official @cloudbase/cloudbase-mcp MCP server if needed and starts its built-in device-code login (shows a link + code to the user) — prefer this for a quick one-click connect. action=connect opens a form for an env-scoped API Key (recommended) or legacy SecretId/SecretKey plus an optional EnvId. action=status reports the current connection; action=disconnect clears credentials and unmounts the server. Once connected, dozens of mcp__cloudbase__* tools become available for document database, relational database (PostgreSQL/MySQL), cloud functions, static hosting, cloud storage, authentication and WeChat mini program integration — call cloudbase_setup with action=status first if those tools are missing or return auth errors.

mcpServers.name: cloudbase
mcpServers.description: Tencent CloudBase (腾讯云开发) backend platform: document/relational database, cloud functions, static hosting, storage, authentication. Call cloudbase_setup to configure.
